source: Georgetown Seafood official May 2026 PDF menu
license: Official restaurant menu evidence; derived menu item names and descriptions only.
notes: Image-based official PDF reviewed from rendered pages. The menu notes some gluten-free labels and a fryer allergy note for fish and wings; these are retained in descriptions where visible. Alcohol and soft drink sections were excluded.

items.name: Hushpuppies
items.description: Southern-style cornbread balls deep fried in corn batter with special sauce. Eight pieces.

items.name: Shrimp Wraps
items.description: Shrimp wrapped in thin pastry filled with ginger, scallions, and herbs; deep fried. Served with celery, carrots, Asian sesame sauce, and lemon. Four pieces.

items.name: Fish Nuggets
items.description: Wild-caught cod deep fried in seasoned batter with tartar sauce and lemon. Seven pieces.

items.name: Fried Calamari
items.description: Squid rings and tentacles deep fried in seasoned batter, topped with shredded carrots and fried onions. Served with cocktail-special sauce and lemon.

items.name: Onion Ring Tower
items.description: Double dipped Spanish red onions in seasoned batter, fried to golden brown and crispy.

items.name: Fried Oysters
items.description: Oysters deep fried in seasoned batter, topped with shredded carrots. Served with lemon and cocktail-special sauce.

items.name: Shrimp Cocktail
items.description: Steamed wild-caught jumbo shrimp tossed in lemon butter and sprinkled with parsley. Served with chopped lettuce, carrots, celery, and cocktail sauce. Labeled gluten-free on the menu.

items.name: Eastern Shore Seafood Salad
items.description: Chilled Maine lobster, real crab meat, scallops, shrimp, seasoned mayo, and lemon served on romaine lettuce with pickle and bread on the side.

items.name: Single Jumbo Lump Crab Cake
items.description: Oven baked blue crab meat served on romaine lettuce with coleslaw or potato salad, special sauce, and lemon.

items.name: Fried Southern-Style Bone-In Wings
items.description: Fried bone-in wings with signature sauces including honey barbecue, buffalo, garlic parmesan, and plain. Dipping options include blue cheese or ranch. Menu notes fryer uses the same oil for both fish and wings.
